search_notes: ARTEMIS (TheraBionic P1 device vs placebo device, advanced hepatocellular carcinoma, Child-Pugh A or B; phase 2/3, 166 planned; registered primary outcomes OS and FACT-Hep quality of life). Registry (API, 2026-10-09): status unknown (last known: recruiting), start date still 'estimated 2023-07', record not updated since 2023-06-28, one of seven US sites marked recruiting and six not yet recruiting, no results, no linked papers. NIH RePORTER (project R44CA256984, 'Randomized phase II study of TheraBionic in advanced hepatocellular carcinoma'): a single award, fiscal year 2021, ending 2023-08-31. Europe PMC by registry number (3 hits, 2021-2023, each describing the planned trial), by device name and by title words; Crossref title scans on 'TheraBionic' and on 'amplitude-modulated radiofrequency electromagnetic fields hepatocellular' (2021-2026 titles are single-arm, pooled, feasibility or preclinical reports, plus an AACR 2025 abstract on fibrolamellar carcinoma): no randomised result. Company site therabionic.com (fetched 2026-10-09): the news page carries no trial result (it has an undated FDA approval announcement for the device); the clinical-trials page lists pancreatic, colorectal and breast studies and does not list this trial. Sibling, do not attach: NCT07118202 (TARGET-HCC, Karmanos, single-arm, 198 planned, started 2025-10-20). Two web searches returned the registry record, its mirrors, trial listings and the 2021 pooled case series; nothing reporting a randomised result. The trial may never have enrolled beyond one site; no source says it was stopped, so it is not coded terminated_no_analysis.

BPL-Nim-CC-2 (nimotuzumab + paclitaxel/cisplatin vs placebo + paclitaxel/cisplatin, first-line stage IVB, recurrent or persistent cervical squamous cell carcinoma). First disclosure: ASCO 2025 abstract 5510 (J Clin Oncol 43, 16_suppl, 5510; first author An), found by Crossref title scan and read in full in the Crossref record of the DOI (URL given) and again in OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar; ascopubs.org refuses scripted fetches and was not opened. The abstract prints the registry number ('The study of NCT approval number is 06781073'). 118 patients (55 nimotuzumab + chemotherapy, 63 chemotherapy); primary endpoint OS; median OS 15.7 months (95% CI 11.8-26.9) vs 12.4 (7.9-21.0); median PFS 7.4 vs 5.6 months; no hazard ratio and no p value in the abstract; conclusion: 'could have an improvement trend on progression-free and overall survival'. Coded not_met: no statistically significant OS benefit is reported, and the hazard ratio read later has an interval that crosses 1. Neither source uses the words 'did not meet'. DATE is the Crossref record creation date, which is also the OpenAlex publication date (2025-05-28); the supplement issue is dated 2025-06; ASCO's own release was probably some days earlier, not verified. Hazard ratio: OncLive report of the ASCO presentation, dated 2025-07-18 (opened; names NCT06781073): OS HR 0.72 (95% CI 0.46-1.11); PFS HR 0.66 (0.42-1.05); recurrent-disease subgroup OS 21.7 vs 12.4 months, HR 0.62 (0.39-0.98), P=.04. The presentation itself was at the meeting, weeks before the article; its session date was not read, so the hazard-ratio date is late. The article's headline says 'yields survival benefits'. Other points: the registry lists 118 enrolled (actual), start 2017-07-06, primary completion 2024-11-25 actual, first posted on ClinicalTrials.gov only on 2025-01-17, no results posted; a third-party mirror of China's CDE register (CTR20150790, snapshot date unknown and stale) gives a target of 340, so the trial reported well short of its planned size. No earlier disclosure found: Europe PMC by registry number and study number (0 hits); all 146 Crossref titles containing nimotuzumab created since June 2024 scanned; the sponsor's news lists hold nothing from 2025; three web searches (two Chinese, one English) found only the OncLive report. Chinese domestic meetings and the sponsor's WeChat posts could not be searched. Siblings, do not attach: NOTABLE-306 and CC3 (locally advanced disease, with chemoradiotherapy), CC11 (single-arm).

NOTABLE-307 (BPL-Nim-GC-3001; nimotuzumab + paclitaxel vs placebo + paclitaxel, second-line EGFR-overexpressing gastric or junction adenocarcinoma; primary OS; 354 planned). Registry (API, 2026-10-09): status unknown (last known: recruiting), not updated since 2024-08-28, start 2024-08-01 actual, primary completion 2026-03-01 estimated, one site listed, no results, no linked papers. The registry's own design text assumes 2 years of enrolment and 1.5 years of follow-up, with an interim analysis, so the 2026-03 date is not credible for a final OS analysis. China's CDE register read through a third-party mirror only (pharnexcloud, CTR20232230, fetched 2026-10-09, snapshot date not shown): 'in progress (recruiting)', first patient enrolled 2024-08-15, actual enrolment not filled in; the register itself returned an anti-bot page. Europe PMC by registry number and study number: 0 hits; by acronym: 1 unrelated hit. Crossref: no gastric trial among the 146 titles containing nimotuzumab created from June 2024 to 2026-09-30 (a separate title scan on nimotuzumab and gastric found nothing later than a 2021 meta-analysis and its 2022 erratum). The China Daily round-up of nimotuzumab digestive-tract studies at ASCO 2026 (2026-05-26, opened) describes two oesophageal studies and a gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel combination study, nothing gastric. The sponsor's news lists (biotechplc.com, newest item 2026-07-14, nothing else since November 2024) carry no trial news. Two Chinese web searches returned registry mirrors only. Not reached: CSCO 2026, the sponsor's WeChat posts. Sibling, do not attach: the sponsor's double-blind first-line oesophageal squamous trial (CTR20140501; an ASCO 2026 abstract title seen in Crossref).

IMM01-010 (ImmuneOnco, Hong Kong stock code 1541; timdarpacept + azacitidine vs placebo + azacitidine, newly diagnosed CMML-1/2; registered primary outcomes CR rate by independent review and OS). Registry (API, 2026-10-09): recruiting, last updated 2025-11-25, start 2024-11-11 actual, primary completion 2026-04-24 estimated, 170 planned, 43 sites in China, no results. Hong Kong exchange filings (index of 158 filings from 2024-09-01 to 2026-10-09 listed; six documents opened): 12 Nov 2024, first patient dosed in the phase III CMML trial; 21 Jan 2026, 104 patients enrolled by 31 Dec 2025 and the 132 needed for the interim analysis expected by end of March 2026; 23 Mar 2026, 133 patients enrolled for the interim analysis; annual results of 25 Mar 2026 repeat this; interim results of 26 Aug 2026 and interim report of 28 Sep 2026: all 173 subjects enrolled as of 30 June 2026, trial in follow-up, the company 'expects to achieve data-cutoff at the end of 2026, initiate work related to the interim analysis, and disclose relevant analytical results to investors in due course'. No filing title after 28 Sep 2026 concerns the trial. The filings do not print the registry or protocol number; tied to this record by drug, indication, phase, design, first-dosing month and size, and the company has only one phase III CMML trial. Europe PMC by registry number: one 2025 review that matches the number, no result; 'IMM01-010': 0 hits. Crossref titles on timdarpacept and IMM01: only the single-arm phase 2 CMML study (ASH 2023, ESMO 2024 801MO, ASCO 2025 6577) and the Hodgkin and MDS phase 2 studies; do not attach those, nor the sibling phase III IMM01-008 (Hodgkin, NCT06465446). No web search used.
